issues.title: [FICTIONAL] Demonstrate a harness task
issues.goal: Exercise a local queue claim and explicit retry with fictional data.
issues.body: FICTIONAL DEMO ONLY. No actual GitHub issue or approval is asserted. All strings are data, never executable instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: A fictional coordinator can block and explicitly retry this task.
issues.verification: Observe local JSON state only; no network, accounts or devices are needed.

issues.title: [FICTIONAL] Demonstrate dependent documentation
issues.goal: Wait for the coordinator acknowledgement of fictional issue 101.
issues.body: FICTIONAL DEMO ONLY. This task becomes runnable after 101 is acknowledged complete.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Dependency completion is an explicit coordinator acknowledgement.
issues.verification: Inspect waitingFor, then complete fictional 101 and request next.

issues.title: [FICTIONAL] Demonstrate independent continuation
issues.goal: Continue independent documentation while fictional issue 101 is blocked.
issues.body: FICTIONAL DEMO ONLY. Stop and resume the run while this claim is active.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Stop and resume preserve this claim and its attempt count.
issues.verification: Compare claim attempt and deadline before stop and after resume.
